description: Land Acquisition - Correction paper Amended Ex Ordinary Gazette No 689/14 dated 20.11.1991
reasoning: The gazette content is a correction to a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act. Its primary subject is the rectification of the recorded extent (in hectares) of a specific parcel of land. The document is explicitly published under "PART III – LANDS". While it is signed by a Minister, the core administrative action pertains solely to a land/property record, not to government structure, personnel changes, or the Minister's portfolio responsibilities. Therefore, it falls under the specialized **Land Gazettes (Type 4)** category.
